caption: The loop takes n = 4, 7, 10, 13 in order; the two highlighted output cells are the passes where both tests are true, so echo prints 7 then 13.

spec.title: for n in 4 7 10 13
spec.aria: A dry-run table of the for loop over 4, 7, 10 and 13: each row shows whether n is odd, whether n is greater than 5, whether both are true, and the printed output, with 7 and 13 printed.
